Name: Portraits for Vanilla Characters
Author: chunnyeol
Description:
♡ ♡ ♡ Hello! ♡ ♡ ♡

To use it is very easy! First, you need to download the Portraiture mod first! (ALSO! The SMAPI and Content Patcher mod too!)

1- Inside the "Mods" folder, find the "Portraiture" folder.

2- On the "Portraiture" folder, find the "Portraits" folder.

3- Create a new folder inside the "Portraits" folder and name it ''Assets'' then move the image files into that new folder.

4-  While talking to any character in the game once the dialogue box is open, press the "P" key until it selects the folder and shows the portraits that you want.
 
Also!! You can select the images that you want to change and if you don't like one of the character's styles, you don't need to use it <3
